Context: ADR 00004 fixed `AdrSettings`'s config resolution so a caller could explicitly pin an MCP session to a specific repo via `adr_set_context(workingDirectory)` - but that fix only searched **upward** from the given directory. It could resolve an exact repo (or any directory inside one), but had no way to discover a repository nested *under* a given directory.
Title: Downward context search and project-name lookup for adr_set_context
